method: Read-only VFS schema4 index, selectively decrypted bundles, decoded serialized Unity objects. Source bundle MD5 and SHA256 checked. No runtime capture.

hover.interpretation: Two finite white/gray flashes at 0,1/30,2/30,3/30 seconds then hold to1/6 seconds. Color segments are smoothstep. Depth channels are authored, but screen displacement needs runtime projection. No scaling or indefinite hover animation in this clip.

ambient.name: watch_loop
ambient.wrap_mode_meaning: Loop; back-and-forth motion is baked in the curve, not a PingPong wrap flag.
ambient.sample_policy: 11 selected original keys per curve, including first,last,quarter,peak and its adjacent frames. These values/slopes are exact; linear degree interpolation is an adapter approximation of baked quaternion curves.

coordinate_adapter.caveat: Content has a 3D tilt. Negating planar z preserves 2D handedness; live camera projection is unverified.

ambient.excluded_from_flat_logo_adapter: EndfieldLogo quaternion z 0→90→0 targets the in-game 3D logo and should not rotate desktop wordmark text.

mesh_topology.name: Equipring
mesh_topology.interpretation: Cylindrical side-wall ribbon: U winds once around Z axis, V spans local Z width. Main texture tiling3 repeats along circumference. A flat annular desktop rendering is a projection approximation.

limitations: No live game rendering or macOS app execution on this Windows host.
